case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising raw-material costs, and we take that seriously. Option A gives your house a longer contract and a steady, binding base for your bar production, which is the part we can offer in return.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar producer prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Option A is the package we can approve: with both cost lines moving down, a longer contract is the better way for us to work together as two family companies on a fair footing.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you do not decide this alone, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who does.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices, and we are pleased to pass these savings on to you in our revised offer.
While we accept the 45-day payment term and the 24-month contract duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over two years is not feasible.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that as a matter of company policy, we do not share our internal cost structures.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

As another alternative, we present a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked again for an index clause on the alloy surcharge, and we have read that request carefully. None of our options contains one, so we are not asking you to carry a fixed price without a binding volume in return. Every option gives you a firm, binding volume for your bar production over the whole term.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a steady, fully committed base for free capacity at a clear price, with payment terms that stay simple for both family companies.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you may need to take this to your pricing committee, please bring Option A to the person who decides on your side. It offers Blankstahl Werdenfels a binding volume across the full term, a contract that keeps its bar production planned, and a price that holds for both sides without further negotiation.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and the offer below answers that: every option carries a firm, binding volume for your bar production over the whole term, which is what fills your free capacity.

We know you need cover against alloy movements, but none of our options contains an index clause. Instead we give you a binding volume and a clear price for the whole term, so you plan without the swings.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.94; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a steady, fully committed base at a clear price, with payment terms that stay simple.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since price changes need approval on your side, please take Option A to the colleague who decides.

Just before we close: what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We acknowledge your offer of a binding volume of 23,700 units per year; please provide the underlying delivery schedules so we can formally verify this commitment. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

While we agree to the 45-day payment term and the 24-month contract duration, we cannot offer a fixed price over two years, making the AS-14404 index clause mandatory. In recognition of your volume commitment, we are prepared to reduce our price to €5.10 per unit, provided the index clause is included. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit. This option includes a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
